meta.note: Receipts from OBR EFO; spending by function from HMT PESA (scaled from 2025-26); debt interest and totals as published.

nominal_gdp_bn.method_note: Fiscal-year nominal GDP, non-seasonally adjusted; OBR's denominator for receipts, spending and deficit ratios.

psnd_pct_gdp.method_note: End-March position over nominal GDP centred on end-March (A.9 footnote).

bank_rate_pct.method_note: MPC decision date: Bank Rate held (not a change).

baseline_psnb_bn.method_note: 2025-26: outturn (ons_psf, ons_psf); later years: OBR forecast.

baseline_psnd_pct_gdp.method_note: 2025-26: outturn (ons_psf, ons_psf); later years: OBR forecast.

baseline_nominal_growth_pct.method_note: Average annual growth of OBR nominal GDP, 2025-26 to 2030-31 (EFO-2026-03).

receipts.label: Stamp duties
receipts.method_note: Sum of A.5 rows: Property transaction taxes + Stamp taxes on shares.

receipts.label: Alcohol & tobacco
receipts.method_note: Sum of A.5 rows: Alcohol duties + Tobacco duties.

receipts.label: Other taxes
receipts.method_note: Sum of the remaining A.5 tax rows: Petroleum revenue tax, VAT refunds, Air passenger duty, Insurance premium tax, Climate change levy, Bank levy, Bank surcharge, Apprenticeship levy, Digital services tax, Other HMRC taxes, Vehicle excise duties, Licence fee receipts, Environmental levies, Emissions trading scheme, Energy profits levy, Electricity generator levy, Other taxes.

receipts.label: Non-tax income
receipts.method_note: Sum of A.5 non-tax rows: Interest and dividends, Gross operating surplus, Other receipts.

borrowing_provenance.method_note: Total spending minus receipts (EFO-2026-03). Published borrowing for 2028-29: 86.0bn.
